games.name: [⚠️] ERROR_CODE
games.desc:
⚠️  Best experienced on PC. Mobile and console are supported, but may not run well.
⚠️  Performance may vary in low-end devices.

Fast paced survival delverlike. You must descend all the way to floor 100. Simple enough, right?
Singleplayer is highly intended, you are able to play with up to 4 people though. (up to 10 in private servers. Though with 5 or more players, no rewards/badges will be rewarded.)

Death is not a punishment, but rather a lesson. Use what your deaths taught you and it will help you improve for next time.

This game is currently in early development, and was made by a small team; Expect missing content, bugs, and unfinished/unbalanced gameplay.
All music used in-game is NOT copyrighted and is completely free to use!

Inspired by Grace (The Fartering Few), DOORS (LSPLASH), Dandy’s World (BlushCrunch Studio), and Murder Drones (Liam Vickers)
